lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Enter your email, and we'll send you a four digit code to verify it.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: From your dashboard, tap New Order.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your order starts out empty. This time you are booking for somebody else.

lines.label: party-members
lines.said: Invite a new party member, with their name and their email.

lines.label: member-added
lines.said: They are on the order now.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Search the catalogue, or open a collection to see what is inside it.

lines.label: pick-the-dates
lines.said: Choose the pickup date, then the return date. [[slnc 300]] Their gear is held for those days.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Now answer a few questions for them, so we can have the gear ready before they arrive. [[slnc 300]] Their height, their boot size, their skill level, their weight and their age. [[slnc 300]] Then agree to the terms and save.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: You rented nothing yourself, and their gear is booked and waiting.
